evals.prompt: Install anti-slop-biome in this established TypeScript monorepo and audit the result without rewriting existing violations.
evals.expected_output: Installs the core profile, preserves existing Biome configuration, runs a bounded audit, and reports diagnostics and conflicts.

evals.prompt: This is a new TypeScript package using Biome 2. Add the strict anti-slop-biome rules.
evals.expected_output: Installs both core and strict rules, recommends relevant built-in Biome rules, and verifies lint configuration.

evals.prompt: Audit our current Biome repo against anti-slop, but do not modify anything.
evals.expected_output: Runs or prepares a read-only audit and does not vendor rules or edit configuration.
